script_text: Stop! Pisces, the stars are screaming at you right now. Neptune, your ruling planet, is forming a harmonious trine to Jupiter in the 9th House, which expands your philosophical outlook and invites Water exploration. Mercury is opposing Mars in the 3rd House, creating friction in your communications and possibly leading to misunderstandings with colleagues or friends. If you're single, Venus in the 5th House ignites a flirtatious encounter, yet you must avoid idealizing your new admirer. For those in a relationship, the Moon in the 7th House highlights partnership dynamics, urging an honest and heartfelt conversation. The Sun in the 10th House squares Pluto, signaling a power struggle at work that could affect your professional reputation and finances. A sudden influx of money may appear from a side project, but impulsive spending could undermine its benefits. Avoid signing any contracts under the stressful Mercury‑Venus square. Follow for tomorrow's reading.
